lenses.finding: NRP HR >=100 branch implied weaning PPV regardless of respiratory effort.
lenses.action: Explicitly continue ventilation for persistent apnea/gasping even if HR is >=100; only wean when breathing adequately.

lenses.finding: Initial oxygen by gestational age was absent from first-pass rapid card.
lenses.action: Added 2025 AHA/AAP gestational-age starting oxygen bands with emphasis on titration and preductal SpO2.

lenses.finding: Chest-tube rapid card implied sweeping adhesions may be routine.
lenses.action: Replaced wording with confirm intrapleural position, do not blindly disrupt adhesions, stop for resistance. Maintained adult eFONA pathway and capnography.

lenses.finding: PPH prompt did not spell out WHO 2025 abnormal vital thresholds and aftercare documentation could be clearer.
lenses.action: Added explicit abnormal hemodynamic triggers, cumulative loss and medication/handoff timestamps. RCOG 2026 guidance link maintained.

lenses.finding: Cross-referencing related rare emergencies required returning to dashboard, increasing taps and attention cost.
lenses.action: Added large one-tap jumps among delivery, neonatal resuscitation, shoulder dystocia, PPH and neonatal epinephrine; checklists still reset on guide exit.
